description.zh-CN: 插件总开关；关闭后停止本地流式网关并完全恢复宿主原生侧边栏行为
description.en: Master switch; disables the local streaming gateway and restores native sidebar behavior when turned off

description.zh-CN: 宿主原生可轻量预览的文件优先保持原生处理，仅在超出体积/行数阈值或无原生预览时自动原位接管
description.en: Keep lightweight files in host native preview and only auto-takeover when exceeding thresholds or lacking native preview

label.zh-CN: 在文件头显示切换按钮
label.en: Show viewer mode toggle in header

description.zh-CN: 在文件查看器标题栏注入 [Omni 检视] 与 [行内 Diff] 快捷控制胶囊
description.en: Show [Omni Viewer] and [Inline Diff] quick toggle pills in the File Viewer header

label.zh-CN: 授权工作区根目录白名单

description.zh-CN: 允许只读流式网关与 Git Diff 访问的本地根目录；留空时默认仅允许宿主当前活跃工作区
description.en: Local root directories accessible to the read-only streaming gateway and Git Diff; defaults to active workspace when empty

label.zh-CN: 启用超大音视频流式检视

description.zh-CN: 支持 HTTP 206 按需拖动、毫秒时间码、逐帧步进与波形打点
description.en: Enable HTTP 206 range seeking, millisecond timecode, frame stepping, and waveform cue markers

description.zh-CN: 达到该体积（或宿主无可用播放器控件）时自动接管；设为 0 表示支持格式全部自动接管
description.en: Auto-takeover when file size reaches this threshold or host has no native media player; 0 takes over all supported media

description.zh-CN: 视频逐帧前进/后退的默认帧率步长基准
description.en: Default FPS baseline for single-frame forward/backward stepping

description.zh-CN: 超过此体积时自动熔断全量波形解码以保护内存，流式拖动与打点仍正常可用
description.en: Skip full audio waveform decoding above this size to save memory while keeping seeking and cue markers active

label.zh-CN: 启用大体积 CSV 流式检视

description.zh-CN: 支持流式分块索引、虚拟滚动、冻结表头与按列检索筛选
description.en: Enable streaming row indexing, virtual scrolling, frozen headers, and column/keyword filtering

label.zh-CN: CSV 自动接管体积阈值 (MB)

description.zh-CN: CSV/TSV 文件体积达到或超过该值时自动进入流式表格检视
description.en: Auto-takeover CSV/TSV files at or above this size

label.zh-CN: CSV 自动接管行数阈值

description.zh-CN: 基于文件头部 64KB 样本估算总行数达到该阈值时自动接管
description.en: Auto-takeover when estimated line count from 64KB header sample reaches this threshold

description.zh-CN: 虚拟滚动每次向本地网关请求的数据行分块大小
description.en: Number of rows fetched per chunk from the local streaming gateway

label.en: Treat first row as frozen header

description.zh-CN: 关闭后将首行作为普通数据行，并自动生成 C1..Cn 列头
description.en: When disabled, treats row 1 as data and generates C1..Cn column headers

label.zh-CN: 启用 SVG 矢量画布检视

description.zh-CN: 支持安全脚本剥离、10%–1600% 无损矢量缩放平移与三态背景切换
description.en: Enable script-sanitized lossless 10%–1600% pan/zoom SVG canvas and background presets

description.zh-CN: 控制打开 .svg 文件时何时自动切入矢量画布检视
description.en: Control when opening .svg files automatically switches into canvas view

label.zh-CN: SVG 自动接管体积阈值 (KB)

description.zh-CN: 仅在接管模式为「超体积阈值自动接管」时生效
description.en: Effective when SVG takeover mode is set to threshold

description.zh-CN: 预设矢量画布衬底模式，便于观察深色或浅色线条
description.en: Default backdrop style for inspecting light or dark vector strokes

description.zh-CN: 支持 .ttf / .otf / .woff2 / .woff 多字号瀑布流样张与字形网格预览
description.en: Preview .ttf, .otf, .woff2, and .woff files with multi-size waterfalls and glyph grids

description.zh-CN: 打开字体文件时自动进入样张检视台（宿主无原生字体预览）
description.en: Automatically open font specimen inspector for font files

description.zh-CN: 超过此体积的字体文件拒绝注入内存并显示安全提示
description.en: Refuse automatic FontFace injection above this file size

description.zh-CN: 留空则使用内置中英数字符号全要素样张
description.en: Leave blank to use built-in multilingual pangram and symbol specimen

label.zh-CN: 启用 Git 安全行内 Diff

description.zh-CN: 在文件查看器及变更抽屉中提供严格只读的工作区代码差异对比
description.en: Provide strictly read-only workspace inline diff in File Viewer and Changes Drawer

label.zh-CN: 默认 Diff 对比范围

description.zh-CN: 打开行内 Diff 时的默认 Git 比较基准
description.en: Default comparison baseline when opening Git inline diff

description.zh-CN: 桌面侧边栏窄宽度推荐使用单栏行内对比（Unified）
description.en: Unified single-column layout is recommended for narrow sidebars

description.zh-CN: 对连续增删行计算并高亮具体修改的字符/词组片段
description.en: Highlight intraline changed tokens across paired deletion/addition lines

description.zh-CN: 每个变更块（Hunk）上下默认保留的未修改代码行数
description.en: Unchanged context lines shown above and below each diff hunk

label.zh-CN: 单文件 Diff 体积熔断上限 (MB)

description.zh-CN: 超出该体积时安全截断并提示熔断横幅，防止大文本卡死渲染线程
description.en: Truncate diff output and display a safety banner above this file size

label.zh-CN: 单文件 Diff 最大行数熔断

description.zh-CN: 单次渲染的最大差异行数上限，超出时截断保护
description.en: Maximum diff lines rendered before safety truncation

description.zh-CN: 底层强制仅绑定 127.0.0.1；推荐使用动态随机空闲端口
description.en: Strictly bound to 127.0.0.1; dynamic random free port is recommended

description.zh-CN: 避开 18765(remote)/18766(proxy)/18767(web)；若被占用将自动回退随机空闲端口并记录告警
description.en: Avoids 18765–18767; automatically falls back to an ephemeral port if occupied

label.zh-CN: 打开工作区 Git 变更
